status: Native task Session resource-binding component qualified; raw wire media and full Gate 4 remain open
qualification: Local macOS arm64, disposable stores and in-process service composition. Native media attachment is not enabled.
behavior: Current Native grant/task/parent/membership and accepted-session checks share one SQLite read transaction.

Attachment requires SessionGet plus the participant role permission (SessionInvite for initiator, SessionAccept for invited participant), a permitted counterpart and a session effect link belonging to the exact task/conversation.
Read-only grants, unrelated or primitive sessions, another task/conversation, unknown IDs, wrong participant role and non-Native origins are denied.
Revocation, expiry, cancellation, narrowed parent authority, lost membership, conversation closure and session end deny subsequent resource authorization.
Store reopen and explicit same-task grant replacement preserve the session; revoked authority stays denied and no additional effect is created.
Service resolver validates the Native principal issuer, installation and expiry; canonical installation-scoped IDs, repeat authorization and existing owner projection are preserved.
Session binding moved into a focused service module; existing public export remains unchanged.
